description:
Convert a number between binary, octal, decimal, hex and any base from 2 to 36, with arbitrary-size integers (BigInt), exact fractional parts (repeating digits in parentheses, e.g. 0.1 decimal = 0.0(0011) binary) and an optional two's complement view at a chosen bit width with signed/unsigned readings and big- and little-endian bytes.

Returns: JSON { fromBase, fraction, binary, octal, decimal, hex, target{ base, value }|null, bitLength, twosComplement{ width, binary, hex, signed, unsigned, bytesBigEndian, bytesLittleEndian, overflow, min, max, maxUnsigned }|null, warnings[] }.
Example input: {"value":"-42","width":16}
On error, includes hint: Digits must be valid in the base (0-9 then a-z). Two's complement needs a whole number and a width; set inputIsPattern to read hex like FFD6 as a signed value.

from.description: Base of the input, 2 to 36. Omit to read it from a 0x/0o/0b prefix, otherwise decimal.

inputIsPattern.description: Read the input as a two's complement bit pattern of `width` bits, so FF at 8 bits is -1. Default false.

to.description: An extra target base besides 2, 8, 10 and 16.

value.description: The number. Accepts a sign, 0x/0o/0b prefixes, '_' separators and a fractional part, e.g. '255', '-42', '0xFF', '10.625'.

width.description: Bit width for the two's complement view (8, 16, 32, 64 or any 1-1024).

name: number_base_convert
title: Number base converter
